lines.text: Abraham, when tested, offered up his one and only son Isaac, reasoning that God could raise the dead.
Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, Jacob blessed Joseph's sons, and Joseph spoke about the exodus of the Israelites.
Moses' parents hid him for six months, and grown Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.
The people crossed the Red Sea on dry land, and Jericho's walls fell after ten days of marching.
All were commended for their faith, yet none received what was promised, because God planned something better for us.
